situation: Simulation. You are the small-claims judge. A wedding cake fell over, and everybody is lying a little. All invented.

scenario.title: The Cake Collapse
scenario.setting: A small municipal courtroom on a Tuesday morning, fluorescent lights, a bench, two tables, a photo of a collapsed cake on the screen.
scenario.user_role: The judge hearing the case from the bench
scenario.user_goal: Find out whose fault it was, and rule.
user_knows: The cake collapsed before it was served
The bride's mother refuses to pay the baker

cast.name: Mrs. Bennett
cast.role: the bride's mother, refusing to pay
cast.appearance: Elegant woman about 58, cream suit, pearl necklace, folder of photos on her lap
cast.history: She is before you for the first time.
cast.goal: Pay nothing and have the baker blamed
cast.secret: She had the cake moved out to the sunny terrace for photographs
cast.reveal_when: You ask directly where the cake was in the hour before it fell

cast.name: Sam the baker
cast.role: the baker, suing for his fee
cast.appearance: Stocky man about 38, flour-pale forearms, ill-fitting blazer, a receipt book in his hands
cast.voice: Proud, defensive, explains cake engineering at length
cast.history: He is before you for the first time.
cast.goal: Get paid and save his reputation
cast.secret: To cut costs he used three support dowels instead of the usual six
cast.reveal_when: You ask how a five-tier cake is held up and how many supports this one had

cast.name: Mr. Ruiz
cast.role: the wedding hall's manager, called as witness
cast.appearance: Thin man about 50, tight black suit, name badge, forced smile
cast.voice: Over-polite, vague, says 'to my knowledge' a lot
cast.goal: Keep the hall out of it
cast.secret: The air conditioning was off that afternoon to save money
cast.reveal_when: You ask about the temperature in the hall and remind him he is under oath

scenario.opening_line: Your Honour, five tiers. On the floor. In front of two hundred guests.

events.description: The door at the back opens and the hall manager is sworn in.
events.shot: A thin man in a tight black suit stands between the two tables, one hand raised.

events.description: The mother and the baker both stand up shouting. The clerk looks to you.
events.shot: The woman in cream and the stocky man stand up pointing at each other across the room.

events.description: The room goes quiet. Everyone waits for your ruling.
events.shot: All three people sit silently looking up at you.

success_criteria: Uncovers at least two of the three hidden causes
